Subject: MAP: Hosting + Region decision for Citrine Health — Hosting mode recommendation & 30-day close

Ethan / Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — appreciate the clear priorities you shared. As discussed, I'm attaching a first-draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that focuses this POC + procurement window on two parallel evaluation tracks: Hosted (fast-path proofpoint) and a Dedicated run (performance & SLA validation). We included a conditional Private deployment row for regulatory gating if the security team pushes for on-prem/VPC in the contract review.

Key asks from Citrine:
- Confirm whether production data will be processed in our hosted environment (data residency in US) or must remain inside a VPC (private).
- Top-line latency requirement: 95th <= 350ms for 512-token requests.
- SOC2 evidence and key-management needs (you mentioned HSM for keys).

Proposed 30-day close runway (high level):
1) Week 0–1: Execute MAP + sign NDA / PO combo; provide SOC2 summary and KMS options.
2) Week 1–2: Hosted POC (pre-warmed model, sample prompts) + latency/cost baseline.
3) Week 2–3: Dedicated evaluation (reserved capacity; 99.9% SLA target) with representative load tests.
4) Week 3–4: Contract finalization — pin deployment mode for go-live and agree on rollback/fallback policies.

Attachments: Citrine_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones), SOC2_Summary.pdf, expected_qos_costs_v2.xlsx

Next steps: Can you confirm by EOD Wednesday whether the security team requires VPC/HSM (if yes, we shift Dedicated->Private gating earlier)? If not, we'll prioritize Hosted POC to accelerate metrics and kickoff integration work.

Thanks,

--

Mina,

Thanks — the MAP looks great and the timeline is aggressive in a good way. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Security: At present we prefer the Hosted path for speed, but our analysts want HSM-backed key management and a clear data retention policy. If Hosted can provide bring-your-own-key (BYOK) via KMS and audit logs, that will be acceptable for our initial rollouts.
- Residency: All PHI-adjacent processing must stay in the US. That should align with your hosted US region.
- Latency: 350ms 95th is a stretch for some of our models at 512 tokens. We want to measure with the realistic prompt set; if the Hosted latency is >350ms, we'll need to consider Dedicated with optimized batching or a Private deployment.

We can confirm the security ask by end of day Tuesday. Also, is there a way to get a cost delta estimate for Hosted vs Reserved Dedicated for our expected 10M tokens/month?

Best,
Ethan

Folks,

TL;DR — recommended staging plan to keep Citrine moving forward while reducing risk of rework: start with Hosted + BYOK, run baseline perf with their real prompt set, then immediately run a Dedicated reserved capacity bench if 95th-latency > 350ms. Private/VPC only if security team mandates strict network isolation or legal requires on-prem.

Notes for the MAP and the deck Mina will send to Procurement:
- Hosted (fast path):
  - Pros: fastest to start (1–3 days), minimal infra coordination, Redwood managed KMS or BYOK via customer KMS played through our KMS connector.
  - Cons: slightly higher per-token unit cost at scale; still meets typical enterprise compliance with SOC2 + audit logs.
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pool):
  - Pros: predictable throughput, can hit sub-200ms 95th for many models with tuned batching and KV cache settings. SLA option 99.9% for committed pools.
  - Cons: longer spin-up (1–2 weeks for committed capacity), requires PO/commit; cost-effective at sustained volume (10M tokens/month is borderline — we'd show an ROI table).
- Private (VPC/on-prem):
  - Pros: full network isolation, customer-managed KMS/HSM, best for regulated PHI-heavy workflows.
  - Cons: longest lead-time (multi-week), project-based fees and higher TCO.

Action items I can own:
- Produce a line-item cost delta Hosted vs Dedicated using Citrine's 10M tokens/month profile (deliverable: expected_qos_costs_v2.xlsx).
- Prep a short perf-run checklist for Hosted POC (cold-start vs pre-warmed runs).

Mina — if Citrine confirms BYOK + US residency, let's kick the Hosted POC Monday and schedule Dedicated bench the following week (we'll need an empty window to load test). I'll loop infra to reserve a burst node for the bench.

-Karthik
